fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior or Sold Post without a disclosed consideration does not receive an inferred price.
Withdrawn Prior or Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale.
Seller top-ups, concessions, turnover rent and gross/net income are kept distinct from passing rent.
Future indexed or fixed rent changes are not treated as current.
Tenant break options and historical lease events are not silently resolved.
Planning, change-of-use, redevelopment and asset-management potential remain subject to consents.
Vacant possession and holding-over occupancy are preserved without inventing a completed letting.
Historical tenancy facts are kept separate from current registry status.
